text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE single full-body image. 2:3 portrait canvas, head-to-toe uncut, complete hair and shoes, 6% margin top and bottom. Strict straight-on FRONT view, head upright face symmetrical, shoulders and hips level, relaxed arms at sides hands visible, feet slightly apart on same baseline. Long lens neutral undistorted straight camera, no perspective foreshortening. Character-specific body: 184 cm, moderate athletic build with gentle broad shoulders. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Olive-brown aviator jacket ending at high hip, cream shirt, cocoa tie, warm stone tailored trousers and dark brown lace-up boots.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Male age 25. Warm black-brown soft wavy hair parted slightly off-center. Amber-brown gently upturned eyes, broad oval face, rounded cheekbones, straighter thick brows, short defined nose, warm broad closed-mouth smile with fuller lips, little dimple. Golden ivory skin. Olive-brown aviator jacket, original small geometric wing emblem without letters, cream uniform shirt, cocoa tie and slim brass tie bar. Kind poised charm.
reproduction_note: 此为带身份参考图生成的补充素材；独立文字提示词已重建，未经纯文生图复现验证。严格同脸请同时使用身份母版。
